name: Bando-Victor Empire
invariants: The empire persists as one governed system.
Components may be paused, replaced, merged, quarantined, or archived without terminating the empire.
Economic claims require evidence; assertions never become revenue merely because a worker reports them.
Genesis Capital provenance is permanent even when its balance is deployed, transformed, or multiplied.
Execution is continuously reorganized toward verified survival, stability, revenue, and family capability without deleting the empire mission.
